description: Explicit allowlist of known evidence-source keys that intentionally have NO capability crosswalk because Honua does not support them. This file exists so a hard Esri lock-in (Utility Network, Parcel Fabric, Linear Referencing) is a loud, reviewed 'not-supported' marker rather than a silent omission from capability-keys.v1.json. CapabilityCrosswalkDriftTests requires every honua-esri-assess CAPABILITY_REGISTRY 'no-go' (hard_lock_in) key to appear here, and forbids it from also appearing in capability-keys.v1.json's crosswalks.esriAssess section.

notSupported.boundary: Utility Network is a hard Esri lock-in: the network topology, rules, and trace engine do not migrate. Federate-only or no-go.
Parcel Fabric is a hard Esri lock-in: the fabric topology and record lineage do not migrate. Parcels move as features only. Federate-only or no-go.
Linear Referencing System (LRS) is a hard Esri lock-in: route/measure calibration and event behaviors do not migrate. Federate-only or no-go.
